notes_ja: 録音の中でギター以外に残る持続音は、8〜11小節のごく小さなシンセのふくらみ（スウェル）だけです（ミックスより約26dB小さい）。8小節で低いD2とE4が静かに立ち上がり、9小節でA2・F#3・C4、10小節でA3が加わってD9の響き（D-A-F#-A-C-E）になり、11小節の2拍目の手前（位置5）で切れます。キーボードなら左手D2＋A2、右手F#3・A3・C4・E4を、アタックの遅い音色で小さく。12小節以降は休み（前の版のパッドの音は、ほとんどがアコギでした）。
method: v3 REWRITE (reconciler; scripts work/v3/reconciler/r05-r10, images pad_synth_7_12.png / pad_mix_7_12.png). The v2 pad.json (bars 1-34) is NOT copied: its notes were the acoustic guitar (intro D3+A3 drone, A-section D3/A3, the A2/G2/B2 low voice = open 5th string, 6th string fret 3, 5th string fret 2) plus a C4/C5 layer at 13b/15b/17b that the harmony verifier attributes to violin double stops. The only sustained non-guitar layer is the synth swell that MVSep Mega-53 puts in its synth stem: RMS relative to the mix bars 1-6 -69..-77 dB (silent), bar 7 -50, bar 8 -40, bars 9-11 -27/-26/-25 dB, bars 12-34 -55..-70 dB (silent). In bars 9-11 the mix itself rises at the synth pitches against bars 3-5 (no synth, no bass yet): D2 +27.2 dB, E4 +12.8, A2 +11.7, F#3 +10.5, C4 +8.1; at those pitches the mix is only 3-10 dB above the synth stem, so the synth carries most of that energy. None of these are guitar notes (standard tuning, no D2; the intro guitar plays D3/A3/D4 only) or violin notes (the violin plays A4/B4/C5/D5 with an open-D drone; at 9.0 and 11.0, where synth C4 is strongest, the violin plays A4). Per-eighth levels in the synth stem (16384-pt FFT): D2 10-17 dB from bar 8, 18-27 dB in 9-11; E4 7-17 dB from 8.3, 12-29 dB in 9-11; A2 15-29 dB from 9.0; F#3 2-24 dB from 9.0; C4 7-33 dB from 9.0 (dips at 9.3/10.4); A3 18-30 dB from 9.5; all fall 15-40 dB between 11.5 and 11.8 (release at about pos 5). Omitted: D3 and E5/F#4/C5 (2nd harmonics of D2/E4/F#3/C4 in level and timing), A3 written from bar 10 (it enters at 9.5; the guitar also plays A3). Bar 8 is barely audible (-40 dB): low confidence. Also checked and NOT a pad: a voice-like layer in all three vocal stems that starts at bar 34 pos 0 (-30 dBFS, F#5/A5 with D4) as the video ends - a sung melody over the last bar, not a sustained accompaniment.
